packageRules.description: Talos — Ottawa only. Scoped per cluster so each cluster upgrades in its own PR and its own tuppr run.
prBodyNotes: ## Talos Upgrade — Ottawa
Updates `talconfig.yaml` and the tuppr `TalosUpgrade` CR together. Both must
move in the same commit: tuppr rolls every node to whatever the CR says once
any spec change bumps its generation, so a CR left behind is a downgrade.
### Before merging:
- [ ] Review [Talos release notes](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases)
- [ ] Verify cluster health
- [ ] Ensure tuppr controller is running
- [ ] Confirm no other cluster's Talos PR is mid-rollout

Updates `talconfig.yaml` and the tuppr `KubernetesUpgrade` CR together.
The tuppr CR carries a deliberate hold and a `# version-sync: ignore` marker.
If this PR touches it, confirm the hold is meant to be lifted and drop the
marker; otherwise keep the CR pinned and let only `talconfig.yaml` move.

packageRules.description: Rook — Ottawa only. Scoped per cluster so one storage control plane moves at a time.
prBodyNotes: ## Rook Operator Upgrade — Ottawa
Bumps the Rook operator chart for **this cluster only**. Robbinsdale has its
own PR; never have two clusters' storage rollouts in flight at once.
Order within a cluster is fixed: **Rook operator first, Ceph daemons second.**
A new operator runs the older Ceph release; the reverse is not supported.
### Before merging:
- [ ] Read the [Rook upgrade guide](https://rook.io/docs/rook/latest/Upgrade/rook-upgrade/)
- [ ] Read the [Rook release notes](https://github.com/rook/rook/releases) for this version
- [ ] Check [Rook issues](https://github.com/rook/rook/issues) for known bugs in this version
- [ ] `tools/kc.sh ot -n rook-ceph exec deploy/rook-ceph-tools -- ceph status` → HEALTH_OK
- [ ] Confirm this cluster's Ceph image PR is not mid-rollout
### After merging:
- [ ] Watch the operator and CSI provisioner rollout finish
- [ ] Back to HEALTH_OK before merging the matching Ceph image PR

packageRules.description: Ceph — Ottawa only. Scoped per cluster so one set of storage daemons rolls at a time.
prBodyNotes: ## Ceph Daemon Upgrade — Ottawa
Moves `CephCluster.spec.cephVersion.image` and the toolbox image together for
**this cluster only**. Both must land in the same commit —
`tools/check-versions.sh` fails the build if the two tags drift.
Rook rolls MON → MGR → OSD → MDS one daemon at a time. Expect degraded PGs
during the OSD phase, and leave the other cluster's Ceph PR alone until this
one is back to active+clean.
### Before merging:
- [ ] **Open Rook operator PR for this cluster? Merge that first.**
- [ ] Confirm the running Rook release supports this Ceph version ([release notes](https://github.com/rook/rook/releases))
- [ ] Read the [Ceph upgrade guide](https://rook.io/docs/rook/latest/Upgrade/ceph-upgrade/)
- [ ] `tools/kc.sh ot -n rook-ceph exec deploy/rook-ceph-tools -- ceph status` → HEALTH_OK, all PGs active+clean
### After merging:
- [ ] Watch each daemon tier roll (mon, mgr, osd, mds) — do not restart pods by hand
- [ ] HEALTH_OK and all PGs active+clean before touching the other cluster
